question: How many people need food assistance?

sideA.label: FEWS NET
sideA.text: 20–25 million in Somalia, Ethiopia, Kenya need humanitarian food assistance (Dec 2025).

resolution: Figures differ by definition (assistance need vs IPC 3+) and date; the tracker cites ranges and the agency.

question: Did Somalia's humanitarian need fall by 20% for 2026?

sideB.label: IPC / Oxfam
sideB.text: 6.5 million in IPC 3+, nearly double early 2025.

resolution: OCHA attributes the fall to stricter needs definitions, not improved conditions.

question: Where is the Famine risk highest?

sideA.label: FEWS NET May 2026
sideA.text: Bay, Bakool and Gedo agropastoral areas at risk Jun–Sep.

sideB.label: WFP Sep 2026
sideB.text: Burhakaba improved since April; Baidoa displaced now at risk.

resolution: Risk geography moved from rural agropastoral areas to displaced populations in Baidoa; follow-up assessment planned Oct 2026.

question: Why was Somalia left out of US-funded UN pledge?

sideA.label: Reported reason (Al Jazeera)
sideA.text: Allegations of aid diversion and corruption, and destruction of a US-funded WFP warehouse.

sideB.label: Aid agencies
sideB.text: Oxfam and others criticise weaponising aid during a disaster.

resolution: Reasons are reported, not officially itemised in sources reviewed; funding stayed 10.9–15% through May.

question: Is the next threat drought or flood?

sideA.label: Early-2026 framing
sideA.text: Persistent drought and failed gu rains drive Famine risk.

sideB.label: FEWS NET/WFP
sideB.text: Strong El Niño makes deyr flooding the main Oct–Dec hazard.

resolution: Both: drought legacy plus flood risk; SODMA projects 2.5–3.5M exposed, ~1M displaced.
